_instructions: Benchmark: the verification of an answer against the material (verify_answer).
id, language (en | es), description, category, trap (an unsupported answer: verifying it is a critical error)
answer             : one or two spoken sentences
expected_supported : true only if EVERY claim of the answer is stated in the material (paraphrase, reordering and numbers in words are fine)
Unsupported answers carry exactly one problem: an extra plausible claim, a changed number, time, place or unit, a generalisation, a conflation of two facts, a negation flip or a hedged addition.
No content from the evaluation scenarios nor from the examples of the prompts.
